title: 第2369章 唐昊第2368章 搜魂
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
随着楚风运转自创魂技，天魔魂力迅速侵入唐昊的大脑，原本痛呼的唐昊，很快就翻起了白眼，嘴里忍不住地吐出白沫。
数秒之后，随着天魔魂力逐渐回流，一幕幕画面出现在了楚风的脑海中，唐昊的一生正在他眼前展现。
唐昊生来就是上三宗之一昊天宗的宗主之子，上面有一个哥哥，且自身是先天满魂力。
凭着这样的出身和天资，唐昊与哥哥唐啸很快有了昊天双星的名号，前半生几乎是一帆风顺，没有遭遇过什么挫折，最危险的时候可能就是在杀戮之都历练时，但由于昊天宗的传承魂技，唐昊始终能够自保。
大约30岁左右的时候，唐昊获取第七魂环，成为魂圣，后与唐啸离开昊天宗游历，最终遇上了辣个女子——
刚化形不久的十万年魂兽蓝银皇阿银。
后来唐啸主动提出离开，唐昊和阿银继续在大陆上游历，期间，唐昊的等级也在持续提升，无愧天才之名。
阿银在与唐昊相识的数年后，向唐昊坦白了自己化形魂兽的身份，唐昊对此表示不在意种族之分，爱可跨越一切。
不久后阿银的身份暴露，武魂殿当时的教皇千寻疾向昊天宗施压，本就重病的唐昊父亲，得知此事后气急攻心而亡。
半晌，楚风以唐昊的视角看到了唐三出生时的战斗，随着阿银献祭给唐昊，唐昊顺势成为了封号斗罗。
明明昊天锤这种武魂距离六翼天使这样的神赐武魂有所差距，可在唐昊的爆种之下，他硬生生重伤了成为封号斗罗多年、且有人相助的千寻疾，成功带着唐三逃走。
‘千寻疾没有下杀手？是顾忌失踪多年的‘大地无敌’唐晨？还是见到阿银死了，就没有继续针对唐昊的必要了？’
楚风注意到了那一战的细节，可以说千寻疾放水了，不过放的不多，毕竟千寻疾实力的确有限。
要不是千寻疾杀心不重，反正楚风是想不到唐三怎么活下来，要知道大战的时候，刚刚成为封号斗罗的唐昊还要护着刚出生的唐三。
对于唐昊的第九魂环为什么是黑中泛红，楚风也在唐昊的记忆中得到了答案。
因为那一战开启的时候，唐昊并没有到90级，成为准封号斗罗，后来还是在阿银的献祭下，凭着献祭仪式的魂力贯注，才从87级一举超过90级。
这最终导致唐昊的第九魂环有些残缺，算不上真正的十万年魂环，且只有一个魂技。
从唐昊的记忆来看，他刚刚获得第九魂环的时候，魂环中的红色还没有如今这么多，按照这样的趋势下去，再过上一些年，没准第九魂环的黑色就会彻底消失，看上去与真正的十万年魂环没有区别。
在阿银死亡后，唐昊陷入了颓废之中，带着唐三隐居在了圣魂村。
再往后就是大家都知道的剧情，只不过唐昊对于唐三的不管不顾，并非他看出自己孩子体内存在着一个异界杀手的灵魂，而是真的不上心，同时也没有养育孩子的经验，也不愿问问村里的别人，全程只想活在自己的世界里。

直到唐三6岁那年觉醒了双生武魂，唐昊这才从自己的世界里走出来，真正关注了唐三。
通过回忆看不出唐昊当时的想法，楚风也不知他转变的原因是从唐三身上看见复仇的希望，还是见到蓝银皇武魂后想起了妻子。
一幕幕画面在楚风脑海中快速闪过，楚风的眉头也渐渐皱了起来。
他没有发现疑似中洲队的人，唐昊、唐三的经历和原着里几乎一样，只是唐三没有遇到小舞。
再然后，岁月流转，将唐三安顿在史莱克学院的唐昊来到了落日森林，看样子是想横穿此地，前往那个居住着万年蓝银王的地方。
那里是唐昊兄弟和阿银的相遇之地，那时阿银的实力并不比唐昊兄弟弱，看样子要是无人打扰，这位化形魂兽可能会在此地修炼到封号斗罗。
由于化形魂兽可以用自己的魂兽本源凝聚魂环，所以阿银连外出猎取魂兽的必要都没有。
‘不愧是活了十万年左右的草类魂兽，也许化形后修炼的那二、三十年，在阿银眼里和一眨眼差不多，对于人类世界的好奇也几乎为零。’
‘唐昊之所以会颓废那么久，是自责要是阿银没遇上自己，她可以顺顺利利的成为封号斗罗吗？’
‘化形魂兽成为封号斗罗后，封号斗罗也无法分辨出化形魂兽的真实身份了。’
楚风心中思绪闪过，没有发现中洲队的踪迹让他有些失望，不过唐昊的记忆还是有一些价值的。
比如繁衍，比如昊天宗传承。
昊天宗的昊天九绝放在这个时代还是很不错的，对于完成主线任务能起到一定作用。
‘万年蓝银王能作为备选的生命系魂环，要是没能猎杀生命系凶兽，就拿它凑数吧。’
楚风心中思索着，他看着已经呆傻的唐昊，手上略一发力，就听清脆的咔嚓声传出，唐昊的脑袋顿时凹陷下去，生机在快速流失。
一团火焰也在此时升腾，将唐昊吞没，将这位昊天斗罗焚烧殆尽。
搜魂摧毁了唐昊的灵魂，而灵魂又是精神力的根基，且人类魂师身体素质一般，楚风的魂力又卡在了50级。
这让他甚至没法废物利用，施展天魔六蚀吸收唐昊的剩余营养，只能任由唐昊的一身营养回归斗罗星的自然循环系统。
直到唐昊以往炼化的一块块魂骨掉落，楚风依旧没有听到主神的声音：‘啧，因为现在的唐昊太弱了，所以杀了连奖励点都没有？’
虽然原剧情里的唐昊在万年之后，会成为斗罗星的位面之主，可那段岁月太遥远了，主神显然不承认。

‘唐昊这种水准的封号斗罗，也就是个b级怪，估计进行过a级强化的轮回者，都没办法从这上面拿到奖励点。’
楚风心中思绪一闪。
掠夺模式的团战能通过杀怪得到奖励点，前提是所杀的怪物和自身在主神那里的评价差不多。
content_en:
As Chu Feng used his self-created soul skills, the devil's soul power quickly invaded Tang Hao's brain. Tang Hao, who was originally screaming in pain, quickly rolled his eyes and foamed at his mouth uncontrollably.
A few seconds later, as the demon's soul power gradually returned, scenes appeared in Chu Feng's mind, and Tang Hao's life was unfolding before his eyes.
Tang Hao was born as the son of the leader of the Haotian Sect, one of the three upper sects. He had an older brother and was innately full of soul power.
With such background and talent, Tang Hao and his brother Tang Xiao soon became known as the Haotian Double Star. The first half of their lives were almost smooth sailing, without any setbacks. The most dangerous time may have been when they were training in the Killing City, but because of the inherited soul skills of the Haotian Sect, Tang Hao was always able to protect himself.
When he was about 30 years old, Tang Hao obtained the seventh soul ring and became a soul saint. Later, he and Tang Xiao left the Haotian Sect to travel, and finally met a hot woman——
A Yin, the 100,000-year-old soul beast Blue Silver Emperor, had just transformed.
Later, Tang Xiao took the initiative to leave, and Tang Hao and A Yin continued to travel on the mainland. During this period, Tang Hao's level continued to improve, and he was worthy of the name of genius.
A few years after meeting Tang Hao, Ah Yin confessed to Tang Hao his identity as a transformed soul beast. Tang Hao said that he didn't care about race and that love could transcend everything.
Soon after, Ah Yin's identity was exposed, and Qian Xunji, the then Pope of Wuhun Palace, put pressure on Haotian Sect. Tang Hao's father, who was already seriously ill, was so angry that he died after learning about this incident.
For a while, Chu Feng saw the battle when Tang San was born from Tang Hao's perspective. As A Yin sacrificed to Tang Hao, Tang Hao became a titled Douluo.
Obviously there is a gap between martial arts like the Clear Sky Hammer and god-given martial arts like Seraphim, but under Tang Hao's explosive seed, he forcibly seriously injured Qian Xunji, who had been a titled Douluo for many years and had someone to help him, and successfully escaped with Tang San.
‘Qianxunji didn’t kill? Are you worried about the ‘Invincible Earth’ Tang Chen who has been missing for many years? Or is there no need to continue targeting Tang Hao after seeing A Yin die? ’
Chu Feng noticed the details of that battle. It can be said that Qianxunji let go, but not much. After all, Qianxunji's strength was indeed limited.
If Qian Xunji hadn't been so murderous, Chu Feng would never have imagined how Tang San could have survived. You must know that during the battle, Tang Hao, who had just become a titled Douluo, had to protect the newborn Tang San.
As for why Tang Hao's ninth soul ring was black and red, Chu Feng also got the answer in Tang Hao's memory.
Because when that battle started, Tang Hao did not reach level 90 and became a quasi-titled Douluo. Later, it was under A Yin's sacrifice and the soul power of the sacrifice ceremony that he surpassed level 90 from level 87 in one fell swoop.
This ultimately resulted in Tang Hao's ninth spirit ring being somewhat incomplete, not really a hundred thousand year spirit ring, and having only one spirit skill.
Judging from Tang Hao's memory, when he first obtained the ninth soul ring, the red color in the soul ring was not as much as it is now. If this trend continues, in a few years, the black color of the ninth soul ring may completely disappear, and it will look no different from a real hundred thousand year soul ring.
After Ah Yin's death, Tang Hao fell into decadence and took Tang San to live in seclusion in the Holy Soul Village.
What follows is the plot that everyone knows, but Tang Hao's disregard for Tang San was not because he saw the soul of an alien killer existing in his child's body, but because he really didn't care. At the same time, he had no experience in raising children, and he didn't want to ask others in the village. He just wanted to live in his own world throughout the whole process.
It wasn't until Tang San awakened his twin martial spirits when he was 6 years old that Tang Hao stepped out of his own world and really paid attention to Tang San.
Tang Hao's thoughts at that time cannot be seen through the recollection, and Chu Feng also doesn't know whether the reason for his transformation was whether he saw the hope of revenge in Tang San, or whether he thought of his wife after seeing the Blue Silver Emperor's martial spirit.
Scenes of scenes flashed quickly in Chu Feng's mind, and Chu Feng's brows graduallyWrinkled.
He found no one suspected of being from the Zhongzhou team. The experiences of Tang Hao and Tang San were almost the same as in the original work, except that Tang San did not meet Xiao Wu.
Then, as time passed, Tang Hao, who had settled Tang San in Shrek Academy, came to the Sunset Forest. It seemed that he wanted to cross here and go to the place where the ten thousand-year-old Blue Silver King lived.
That was the place where brothers Tang Hao and Ah Yin met. At that time, Ah Yin's strength was no weaker than that of Brother Tang Hao. It seemed that if no one disturbed him, this transformed soul beast might be able to cultivate to the title Douluo here.
Since the transformed soul beast can use its own soul beast origin to condense soul rings, A Yin doesn't even need to go out to hunt soul beasts.
‘As expected of a grass-type soul beast that has lived for about a hundred thousand years. Perhaps the two or thirty years of cultivation after transformation were no more than the blink of an eye in A Yin’s eyes, and his curiosity about the human world was almost zero. ’
'The reason why Tang Hao was decadent for so long was because he blamed himself. If A Yin had not met him, would she have successfully become a titled Douluo? ’
‘After the transformed soul beast becomes a titled Douluo, the titled Douluo will no longer be able to tell the true identity of the transformed soul beast. ’
Thoughts flashed through Chu Feng's mind. He was a little disappointed that he found no trace of the Zhongzhou team, but Tang Hao's memory still had some value.
Such as reproduction, such as Haotian Sect inheritance.
The Haotian Nine Jue of Haotian Sect is still very good in this era, and it can play a certain role in completing the main mission.
‘The Ten Thousand Years Blue Silver King can be used as an alternative life-type soul ring. If you fail to hunt down the life-type ferocious beast, use it to make up for it. ’
Chu Feng was thinking in his heart. He looked at Tang Hao who was already stunned. He exerted a little force on his hand and heard a clear clicking sound. Tang Hao's head suddenly sunk and his vitality was rapidly draining away.
A ball of flame also rose at this moment, engulfing Tang Hao and burning the Haotian Douluo to death.
The soul search destroyed Tang Hao's soul, and the soul is the foundation of spiritual power, and the physical fitness of human soul masters is average. Chu Feng's soul power is stuck at level 50.
This made it impossible for him to even use the waste. He used the Six Eclipses of Heavenly Demon to absorb Tang Hao's remaining nutrients, and could only let all of Tang Hao's nutrients return to Douluo Star's natural circulation system.
Until the pieces of soul bones that Tang Hao had refined in the past fell, Chu Feng still didn't hear the Lord God's voice: 'Tsk, because Tang Hao is too weak now, so he doesn't even get reward points for killing him? ’
Although Tang Hao in the original plot would become the Lord of the Douluo Planet in ten thousand years, those years were too far away, and the Lord God obviously did not recognize it.
'A Titled Douluo of Tang Hao's level is just a B-level monster. It is estimated that reincarnators who have undergone A-level enhancement will not be able to get reward points from this. ’
Chu Feng's thoughts flashed in his mind.
In team battles in plunder mode, you can get reward points by killing monsters, provided that the monsters you kill are similar to your own evaluation from the main god.
